title: TVM Affidavit
notes: Primary case affidavit; internal architecture reviewed.

title: World Treasury chronology
notes: Same-ecosystem chronology; useful for dates and instrument names, not issuer authentication.

title: King Solomon Trust succession claims
notes: Later successor-claim ecosystem.

title: 2018 purported nullification of TVM immunity
notes: Adverse same-ecosystem instrument; authority and jurisdiction unresolved.

title: Supreme Court E-Library — Lagcao v. Judge Gako, A.M. No. RTJ-04-1840
notes: Official Supreme Court record establishes that litigants asserted OCT T-01-4, Decree No. 297, Case No. 475 and 3957-P; it also records judicial serious doubts about a Tallano Estate ownership claim. It does not itself authenticate OCT T-01-4.

title: Supreme Court — Lihaylihay v. Treasurer of the Philippines, G.R. No. 192223
notes: Official Supreme Court decision reproduces Tallano/3957-P/gold allegations as claims presented by petitioner. This verifies litigation history, not truth of the underlying title or asset allegations.

title: Supreme Court — Rhema International Livelihood Foundation v. Hibix, G.R. Nos. 225353-54
notes: Official Supreme Court decision records a purported 3957-P writ of execution as non-operative after a Court of Appeals injunction. Material adverse enforcement-history evidence; title validity was not the issue decided.

title: Presidential Decree No. 1529 — Property Registration Decree
notes: Official Philippine property-registration framework. Section 40 provides the registry mechanics for entry and effect of an Original Certificate of Title; used as authentication-control law, not proof of OCT T-01-4.

title: Republic Petition for Annulment of Judgment — Civil Case No. 3957-P research copy
notes: External adversarial pleading copy challenges the OCT T-01-4/reconstitution narrative. Requires official court-file authentication before being treated as a verified primary pleading.

title: BSP — 1949-2019 Story of Philippine Central Banking
notes: Official BSP institutional history confirms RA 265 was signed by President Quirino on 15 June 1948 and establishes the historical Central Bank framework relevant to AUTH-002. Does not authenticate the Gift of Love or Certificate of Entitlement.

title: American Presidency Project — Quirino/Truman chronology, 11 Aug 1949
notes: Independent presidential chronology records President Quirino in Washington and a Truman-Quirino joint statement on 11 Aug 1949. Creates a location/execution authentication test for any alleged Quirino instrument bearing that date.

title: 2018 Urgent Letter to President Duterte — Certificate chronology
notes: Claimant-side letter distinguishes the alleged 11 Aug 1949 Gift of Love proclamation from an alleged CBP Certificate of Entitlement issued 4 Oct 1976. Useful chronology lead; issuer authenticity and asset assertions remain unresolved.

title: Alpha Omega — Certificate of Entitlement / Gift of Love documentary reproduction
notes: Same-ecosystem reproduction/description of Certificate of Entitlement and related asset claims. Establishes claimant-side documentary continuity but not independent governmental authentication.

title: King Solomon Trust — Last Will & Testament dated 11 August 1952
notes: Claimant-side publication identifies an 11 August 1952 Last Will & Testament as a succession instrument for TVM-LSM-666. Establishes persistence and specificity of the claim, not due execution or probate.

title: World Treasury — 11 August 1952 signing and notarization chronology
notes: Claimant-side chronology identifies the 1952 will and names Maria Cristina III, Isabela III, Enimecia Cruz Villamor, and Capt. Jesus Antonio Cruz Villamor as initiating participants.

title: Alpha Omega — 1952 Last Will description and named participants
notes: Provides a more detailed claimant-side description of the 1952 instrument, including the terminology Jus Civile – Agnates – Sui Heredes and asserted participant capacities. Requires primary document and probate authentication.

title: Republic Act No. 386 — Civil Code of the Philippines, Articles 804-806
notes: Official controlling testamentary-form framework effective by 1952. Establishes writing, signature, witness, attestation, page, and notarial acknowledgment requirements for ordinary wills.

title: Philippine Rules of Court — Rule 75, Production of Will / Allowance Necessary
notes: Official probate control framework: no will passes real or personal estate unless proved and allowed in the proper court. Used as the core probate authentication gate.

title: Independent historical record — Jesús Antonio Villamor
notes: Independent governmental historical material corroborates the real identity and military distinction of Jesús Antonio Villamor. It does not establish participation in the 1952 will.

title: King Solomon Trust — Last Will and Testament dated 7 April 1962
notes: Claimant-side publication specifically identifies a 7 Apr 1962 Last Will and Testament and describes it as governing succession from KORAN-FLAT-CRUZ, VILLAMOR, TALLANO family-clan / trustee-depositor interests to TVM-LSM-666. Does not establish execution, probate or asset ownership.

title: Alpha Omega — KORAN/FLAT/TVM-LSM-666 documentary continuity
notes: Later claimant-side publication repeatedly links KORAN, FLAT, TVM-LSM-666 and 010-22-74-O-A to alleged trust deposits and bullion. Useful for nomenclature/provenance tracing only; bank-side and issuer-side authentication remain required.

title: Alpha Omega urgent-letter compilation — later KORAN/FLAT ownership-trusteeship assertions
notes: Later compilation reproduces detailed KORAN/FLAT/global-account ownership and trusteeship assertions. It demonstrates downstream claim continuity, not authenticity of the alleged 1962 will or balances.
